newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.233 billion yuan from 1.986 billion yuan last Friday with the 30-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading was quiet with the head offices of state banks trading less than usual due to ample money in hand.
They said a ban on state banks trading on the state debt repurchase and spot market had increased their cash holdings.

"Banks had traded heavily on the interbank market before the central bank announced the ban and their withdrawal made volume thin," a trader said. "But with the central bank ordering the banks to gradually shift their positions on the repo market to the interbank market, turnover will go up in the mid-term." Traders said they expected the interbank rates to move narrowly in slow trading in the next few days.
